content:
The shaded region is a sector of the disk, so the probability a uniformly chosen point lies in it is the ratio of its central angle to \(360^\circ\).

The upper half of the disk is a straight angle of \(180^\circ\). Along the top side:
\[
40^\circ + (\text{shaded angle}) + 45^\circ + 25^\circ = 180^\circ.
\]
Thus,
\[
\text{shaded angle}=180^\circ-(40^\circ+45^\circ+25^\circ)=70^\circ.
\]
Therefore the probability is
\[
\frac{70}{360}=\frac{7}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{7}{36}}
\]
